# ProfilleAI

> ProfilleAI is an AI-powered job platform: an AI profile and resume builder, per-job resume tailoring, AI cover letter generation, a resume scoring/analysis tool, AI-driven job matching, and ApplyPilot — a Chrome extension that fills out real job application forms on ATS platforms like Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and iCIMS. The free plan requires no credit card and includes a limited monthly/lifetime allowance of tailoring, cover letters, and parsing; ApplyPilot's autofill and auto-apply is a Pro+ feature.

Core product pages:
- [Home](https://www.profilleai.com/): overview of the platform.
- [Pricing](https://www.profilleai.com/pricing): Free, Pro, and Pro+ plans, feature-by-feature comparison.
- [ApplyPilot](https://www.profilleai.com/applypilot): the Chrome extension that autofills and can auto-apply to job postings.
- [Jobs](https://www.profilleai.com/jobs): AI-matched job feed, with ghost-job likelihood scoring applied to listings.
